list.title: News
list.empty_description: “New article” creates a draft and opens it in the editor. Set the category and date back here afterwards.
list.no_match_published_filter: No published articles match this filter
list.no_match_undated_filter: No undated articles match this filter
list.across_statuses_one: {count} article match across all statuses. Widen the filter or clear the search.
list.across_statuses_other: {count} articles match across all statuses. Widen the filter or clear the search.
list.nothing_in_archive: Nothing in the archive matches. Try a shorter search.

row.delete_description: The article and its body are removed, and its public URL stops working. This cannot be undone from here.
row.trash_description: It comes off the public site and out of this list. Restore it from Trash to put it back exactly as it was — trashing does not free its URL for reuse.

new_article.title: New article
new_article.description: Four fields, all changeable later. Creating opens the editor for the body.
new_article.language_help: Fixed once the article exists. To publish the same story in another language, add a translation from the editor.
new_article.url_needed: No address could be made from this headline. Type one using letters, numbers and hyphens, or leave it blank and one will be generated for you.
new_article.date_help: The date shown on the article — it does not schedule a publish. Clearing it makes it undated work in progress.
new_article.empty_response: The server created the article but returned nothing.

editor.body_card_title: The body has its own canvas
editor.body_card_description: Blocks, autosave and revision history live there. This screen owns everything else — category, tags, display date, byline and how the article behaves in feeds.
editor.delete_description: The article, its body and its tags are removed, and its public URL stops working. This cannot be undone from here.
editor.trash_description: It comes off the public site and out of the list. Restore it from Trash to put it back exactly as it was — trashing does not free its URL for reuse.

inspector.slug_invalid: Lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens, starting with a letter or number.
inspector.slug_help: Changing this moves the article. The old address keeps working — a rename records a redirect, because it is already in bookmarks and in a search index that has not recrawled.
inspector.date_help_future: The date shown to readers. It does not publish anything — use Go live for that.
inspector.date_help_past: Clearing the date makes this undated work in progress, which sorts to the top of the list.
inspector.pin_label: Pin to the top of listings
inspector.pin_help: Sorts before the date rather than changing it, so the archive still reads correctly once it is unpinned.
inspector.feed_help: Off keeps the article at its own URL and out of the chronological feed.

review.heading: Review
review.with_reviewer: With a reviewer. You will see their note here if it is sent back.
review.submitted: Submitted for review. Approving publishes it in the same action, so read it as a reader will before you decide.
review.can_publish: You can publish directly. Submitting instead puts it in front of another reviewer.
review.hand_over: Hand this to someone who can publish it.
review.reject_description: The note appears on the body canvas, where the author is working. It clears when they resubmit.
review.published_help: This article is live. Unpublishing takes it off the public site and keeps the draft.
review.unpublish_description: Readers will stop seeing it straight away. The draft and its history are kept, and you can publish it again.
review.unpublish_failed: Could not unpublish. Check the message and try again.

schedule.heading: Schedule
schedule.help: Both are optional, and clearing one cancels it. The article changes state within a minute of the time you set, not exactly on it.

seo.heading: Search & sharing
seo.summary_help: Shown under the headline in a search result and in a shared link. Also the excerpt in the archive and in feed blocks, so it is worth writing even for a site nobody searches.
seo.image_help: The picture a link preview shows, and the cover at the top of the article.
seo.canonical_placeholder: Leave blank to use this article's own address
seo.canonical_help: Only for an article republished from somewhere else — it points search engines at the original instead of this copy.
seo.index_label: Allow search engines to index it
seo.index_help: Off sends {directive} and drops the article from the sitemap. It stays readable to anyone with the link.

history.heading: History
history.empty: Nothing yet. Submitting, publishing or taking the article down records a row here.
history.restore_description: The body you are working on is replaced by the one saved at this point. Anything written since is lost unless it was itself recorded here.
history.restored_toast: Draft restored — reopen the body canvas to see it

translations.heading: Languages
translations.empty_response: The translation was created but not returned.

body.title: {title} — body
body.select_a_block: Select a block to edit it. The headline, URL and publish date belong to the article — edit them on the article screen.

categories.title: Categories
categories.description: One category per article, many tags. The category drives the public /news filters and every feed block.
categories.help: Drag to change the order categories appear in the public /news filter bar. Deleting one asks where its articles go — nothing is deleted with it.
categories.system: system category · cannot be deleted or renamed
categories.delete_empty: The category is empty, so nothing moves. The public filter loses one entry.
categories.delete_moving_one: {count} article will move to {destination}. Nothing is deleted with the category — the articles keep their body, slug and date.
categories.delete_moving_other: {count} articles will move to {destination}. Nothing is deleted with the category — the articles keep their body, slug and date.

tags.heading: Tags
tags.description: Freeform, and made while writing. Select two to merge them.
tags.no_match: No tag matches "{query}". Create it above.
tags.empty: No tags yet. They appear here as writers add them to articles.

trash.title: Trash
trash.description: Articles you have deleted. Restoring puts one back exactly as it was.
trash.purge_description: The article, its body, its tags and its redirects are removed permanently. This cannot be undone.

search.title: Search
search.description: Headlines, slugs, body text, categories, tags and filenames — across articles, pages and media.
search.prompt_description: The same index the Articles and Pages lists use — those scope themselves to their own section, this one does not.
search.no_match_description: Try a shorter search — this looks in headlines, slugs, body text, categories, tags and filenames.

preview.label: Preview
preview.detail_pending: Readers cannot see this until it is approved.
preview.detail_unpublished_changes: Readers are still being served the published version.
preview.detail_published: This matches what readers are served.

definitions.label: Definitions
definitions.items: One per line — "term | what it means"

sources.label: Sources
sources.items: One per line — "what it is | https://…"

contents.label: Contents
contents.hint: Contents lists this article's section headings. Add at least {min} Heading blocks and they appear here, and on the published page.

gallery.label: Gallery
gallery.images: One per line — "https://… | alt text | caption"

table.label: Table
table.rows: One row per line, cells split by |

errors.pattern_mismatch: {field} contains characters that are not allowed.
errors.gone: This article was moved to the trash or deleted.
